description: This file implements a Slack provider for a monitoring system, handling Slack socket and HTTP modes, including connection management, event handling, token validation, and allowlist resolution.

classes.name: SlackBoltResolvedExports
classes.description: Type representing the exports from the @slack/bolt module, including App and HTTPReceiver constructors.

classes.name: SlackSocketShutdownClient
classes.description: Type representing the Slack socket client with optional shuttingDown flag.

methods.name: isConstructorFunction
methods.description: Checks if a value is a constructor function.

methods.name: resolveSlackBoltModule
methods.description: Resolves the @slack/bolt module exports from a given object.

methods.name: resolveSlackBoltInterop
methods.description: Resolves the Slack Bolt module exports from default and namespace imports.

methods.name: getSlackBoltInterop
methods.description: Lazily resolves and caches the Slack Bolt module exports.

methods.name: parseApiAppIdFromAppToken
methods.description: Extracts the API app ID from a Slack app token.

methods.name: publishSlackConnectedStatus
methods.description: Updates the status to indicate Slack connection is active.

methods.name: publishSlackDisconnectedStatus
methods.description: Updates the status to indicate Slack disconnection, optionally with error info.

methods.name: resolveSlackSocketShutdownClient
methods.description: Resolves the Slack socket client from an app object.

methods.name: gracefulStopSlackApp
methods.description: Gracefully stops a Slack app, setting shuttingDown flag if socket client exists.

methods.name: formatSlackResolvedLabel
methods.description: Formats a label for Slack resolution entries with ID and optional extra info.

methods.name: formatSlackChannelResolved
methods.description: Formats a Slack channel resolution entry into a string.

methods.name: formatSlackUserResolved
methods.description: Formats a Slack user resolution entry into a string.

methods.name: monitorSlackProvider
methods.description: Main function to monitor Slack, managing connection, event handling, token resolution, and allowlist processing.
